redfin.remarks: NEW PRICE — an exceptional Studio City value. Offering approximately 1,271 square feet of beautifully renovated loft-style living, this spacious one-bedroom, two-bath residence delivers the size, style, and location rarely found at this price point. Completely renovated in 2021, the home features soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a dramatic open floor plan. The remodeled kitchen is designed for both entertaining and everyday living, with premium KitchenAid stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, an oversized quartz island , and handcrafted finishes. The expansive living area features a cozy fireplace , custom built-ins, and plenty of room to create separate living, dining, and work-from-home spaces. Upstairs, the private primary suite overlooks the main living area and includes a walk-in closet, private balcony, and spa-inspired bathroom with soaking tub, separate shower, and designer tile. Additional features include a guest powder room, dedicated workspace, smart-home features, recessed lighting, central HVAC, and in-unit laundry. Two secure parking spaces, a private EV charger, extra storage, bike storage, and earthquake insurance covered by the HOA add even more value. Just moments from Ventura Boulevard, Erewhon, Equinox, Sugarfish, Whole Foods, Gelson’s, the Studio City Farmers Market, Beeman Park, Fryman Canyon, and some of Studio City’s best dining and shopping. Over 1,270 square feet, extensively renovated, two parking spaces, EV charging, and a prime Studio City location — now offered at $700,000. If you’ve been waiting for the right combination of space, condition, location, and value, this is it.
